set: B: the last two keys and the native-size crops of the page's text and controls

issues.where: the silver numbered discs in the progress rail
issues.what: The strong bevels and shadows make the inactive markers look like enabled push buttons, even though the crop gives no cue about whether steps can be revisited.
issues.fix: Keep the mechanical rail, but make unavailable markers flatter and distinguish completed steps from future ones. Reserve the raised button treatment for markers the user can actually press.

issues.where: the Background Check sign behind the upper-right spiral
issues.what: The spiral and its upright supports cover most of the second line, so the label is harder to read than the other named stations in the same view.
issues.fix: Mount the sign on the front of the assembly or lift it above the rails so both lines are readable from this camera angle.
